description: Canonical form of an ORIX automation document, as written by the code view. Uses only type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, pattern and numeric/length bounds. Without $ref, nested steps are described in full for 2 container levels under spec.steps (1 under spec.onError) and accepted as any object beyond; cross-field rules (exactly one step kind, DAG of needs, expressions, permissions) are enforced by the ORIX validator, not by this schema.

layout.description: Visual editor node positions keyed by step id.

onError.description: Handler steps run when the workflow fails.

items.description: A step. Exactly one kind key: tool, agent, if, switch, foreach, parallel, while, approval, delay, set, transform, verify, subworkflow, notify, fail, output.

agent.description: agent step: profile name, or inline {instructions, model?, tools?}.

approval.description: approval step: message shown to the person.

artifacts.description: output step: paths recorded as run artifacts.

as.description: foreach step: loop variable name (default item).

value.description: Value compared with the switch expression.

collect.description: foreach step: body step whose output is collected per iteration.

concurrency.description: foreach step: iterations run at once (default 1).

default.description: switch step: ids that run when no case matches.

delay.description: delay step: seconds, or an expression yielding seconds.

else.description: condition step: ids that run when the condition is falsy.

expect.description: agent step: file postconditions checked by the runtime.

items.description: One assertion: exactly one of fileExists, fileNonEmpty, fileContains (+ text), dirNonEmpty, equals, truthy, stepSucceeded.

dirNonEmpty.description: Path of a directory that must contain at least one entry.

equals.description: Two values that must be equal after interpolation.

fileContains.description: Path of a file that must contain `text`.

fileNonEmpty.description: Path of a file that must exist and be larger than zero bytes.

stepSucceeded.description: Id of an upstream step that must have succeeded.

truthy.description: Expression (or value) that must be truthy.

foreach.description: foreach step: expression yielding a list, or a literal list.

id.description: Unique in the whole document, nested steps included.

into.description: transform step: variable that also receives the value.

needs.description: Ids of steps of the same list that must finish first.

objective.description: agent step: what the agent must achieve.

onError.description: Id of a handler step of the same list.

steps.description: Nested steps (their own `needs` namespace).
